# Setup
![](/images/start.png){style="width:200px; background:white; border-radius:15px; border:white solid 5px" fig-align="center"}

Before carrying out any analysis we need to get our workshop data and setup our environment.

## Workshop data
![](/images/data.png){style="width:150px; background:white; border-radius:15px; border:white solid 5px" fig-align="center"}

Before copying over the workshop directory ensure you are in your home directory.


::: {.cell}

```{.bash .cell-code}
cd ~
```
:::


Now copy the specified folder to you home directory.


::: {.cell}

```{.bash .cell-code}
cp -r /pub14/tea/nsc206/NEOF/QC_workshop/ .
```
:::


Before running any examples  change directory to the Illumina Quality control directory.


::: {.cell}

```{.bash .cell-code}
cd QC_workshop/Illumina_QC/
```
:::


## Mamba
![](/images/mamba_logo.png){style="width:200px; border-radius:15px; background:null" fig-align="center"}

This book requires some packages.
Miniforge was used to install them.
To learn more about Miniforge and how to create your own environment please see the [appendix](/appendix/mamba.qmd).

To set-up your environment for this book please run the following code (you must include the full stop and space at the front of the command).


::: {.cell}

```{.bash .cell-code}
. useilluminaqc
```
:::


You will have successfully activated the environment if you now see `(illumina_qc)` at the start of your command prompt. 
This indicates you are now in the mamba environment called `illumina_qc` created by the instructor.

If you are interested in the use script you can look at its contents.


::: {.cell}

```{.bash .cell-code}
less /usr/local/bin/useilluminaqc
```
:::


__Tip:__ press `q` to quit `less`.

For more about mamba and how to create your own `illumina_qc` environment please see the [appendix](/appendix/mamba.qmd).
